title: Construction/upgrading/rehabilitation of Drainage along National Roads, Calamba--sta. Cruz, Famy Jct RD
description: CONSTRUCTION/UPGRADING/REHABILITATION OF DRAINAGE ALONG NATIONAL ROADS - SECONDARY ROADS - CALAMBA--STA. CRUZ-FAMY JCT RD-K0105 + 593 - K0105 + 620, K0105 + 715 - K0105 + 718
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱261.6M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Drainage along roads, 112 past contracts) is ₱169.4M per km. Length read from the title: 27 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.
